start: Gym tab, no-gym ('Join your gym') screen, app user with no gym joined

user_sees: 'Is your gym not on MettleUp yet?'
'MettleUp is also software that gym owners use to run their gym. ... Every member of a MettleUp gym gets every feature of this app free, and can also get their trainer's workout plans in it.'
Button 'Recommend MettleUp to my gym'
must_not: Clipped half-sentences
The card shown to a member already in a MettleUp gym

user_sees: The phone's share menu with 'Our gym could use MettleUp. ... Have a look: https://gyms.mettleup.fit/?from=member'
must_not: A link without ?from=member
A message sent without the person picking an app and tapping send

steps.action: Pick WhatsApp and send it to the owner
user_sees: WhatsApp shows the ready text; back in the app the same screen
must_not: The app sending anything on its own

start: The intro slides on first open (the recommend button on a slide)

steps.action: Tap the recommend button on the slide
user_sees: The same share menu with the same text and link
must_not: Different words from the Gym tab card
The slides moving on by themselves

steps.action: Tap 'Recommend MettleUp to my gym', then close the share menu without picking
user_sees: The no-gym screen unchanged
must_not: An error box
'Sent' shown when nothing was sent

steps.action: Phone with no app that can share text
user_sees: The screen stays; nothing breaks (the failure is only logged)
must_not: A crash

start: The person joins a MettleUp gym later

steps.action: Join a gym with its code, open the Gym tab
user_sees: The gym's home; the recommend card is gone
must_not: The recommend card still shown inside a joined gym

user_sees: The no-gym screen and the card again
must_not: The card missing after leaving

start: Shared link opened by the gym owner

user_sees: The MettleUp gym-owner page; the lead is marked 'from a member's shared link' only
must_not: The member's name or number in the link or the lead
Any of the member's workouts sent
